lines.text: There's a tiny thrill in finding real mail in your mailbox.
Not a bill. Not a flyer. Something someone picked out, just for you.
That's the feeling behind Postpop.
Postpop turns your phone photos into real, printed postcards.
The beach on your last night away,
the birthday cake that almost made it,
or the first tomato from your balcony.
It's a really good tomato.
It is a very good tomato.
Add a note, a doodle, and tap send.
Wait, do I need a stamp?
Nope.
We print it, stamp it, and post it for you.
Send one, or send it to the whole family.
Follow it on a map, and get a ping when it lands.
Last-minute person? Schedule cards weeks ahead.
Birthdays. Thank yous. Grandparents. Long-distance friends. Or just because.
Can I send one to myself?
We won't judge.
So go on. Make someone's mailbox the best part of their day.
Postpop. Real mail, from your phone.
